title: The Great Adventure: DJ Bobo on the changing dynamics of DACH touring
summary: With a touring career of over 30 years, DJ Bobo finds himself in a specific position known well to domestic English language acts touring the DACH region. title: ‘DC has raised the bar for ticketing reform nationwide’
summary: Councilmembers in the US’s District of Columbia (D.C.) voted unanimously to pass The Resale Act yesterday (14 July), greenlighting landmark legislation that could transform resale in the country’s capital district. If signed off by Mayor Muriel Bowser, The Resale Act will strengthen consumer protections for those in the federal district by establishing a 10% price cap on resale tickets, banning speculative ticket sales, and requiring mass resellers to register for a license. summary: With 100 shows at London’s The O2 arena under his belt, KMJ Entertainment Group CEO Stuart Galbraith has earned the venue’s prestigious Gold Brick Award. summary: United Talent Agency (UTA) has promoted James Wright to co-head of its UK Music group, with the agent set to join Neil Warnock at the helm of the London-based team. title: AXS expands APAC presence with Hordern Pavilion tie-up
summary: Australia’s Hordern Pavilion has selected AXS as its next official ticketing partner, expanding the global ticketing company’s foothold in the Asia-Pacific region.
